svg.title: Zero Trust Access
svg.desc: Zero Trust Access. No implicit trust from network location: verify identity, device and context on every request. Step 1, The perimeter's flaw: One stolen VPN password passes the wall, then moves sideways: inside, nothing asks again. Step 2, Verify every request: No trusted network: each request stops at a PEP, and identity, device and context decide. Step 3, Least privilege: A decision covers one resource for one session: the tablet reads the wiki, not the database. Step 4, Keep evaluating: Signals change mid-session, so the decision is made again: cut, or challenged, and logged.

g.text: One stolen VPN password passes the wall, then moves sideways: inside, nothing asks again.
No trusted network: each request stops at a PEP, and identity, device and context decide.
A decision covers one resource for one session: the tablet reads the wiki, not the database.
Signals change mid-session, so the decision is made again: cut, or challenged, and logged.
One check at the edge: a firewall, and a VPN for remote staff.
Past the wall, being on the network is the permission.
one implicit trust zone: inside means trusted
flat: every machine can reach every other
sideways, hop by hop: nothing asks again
Signals, read again for every request
used to spot misuse and tune policy
one session, one resource: read only
session cut: the laptop is no longer compliant
same session, new country: sign in again
allowed: a rule names this service
no VPN: straight to the application’s PEP
